candidates.title: Breaking the Layer Barrier: Remodeling Private Transformer Inference with Hybrid CKKS and MPC
candidates.abstract: This paper presents an efficient framework for private Transformer inference that combines Homomorphic Encryption (HE) and Secure Multi-party Computation (MPC) to protect data privacy. Existing methods often leverage HE for linear layers (e.g., matrix multiplications) and MPC for non-linear layers (e.g., Softmax activation functions), but the conversion between HE and MPC introduces significant communication costs. The proposed framework, dubbed BLB, overcomes this by breaking down layers into fine-grained operators and further fusing adjacent linear operators, reducing the need for HE/MPC conversions. To manage the increased ciphertext bit width from the fused linear operators, BLB proposes the first secure conversion protocol between CKKS and MPC and enables CKKS-based computation of the fused operators. Additionally, BLB proposes an efficient matrix multiplication protocol for fused computation in Transformers. Extensive evaluations on BERT-base, BERT-large, and GPT2-base show that BLB achieves a $21\times$ reduction in communication overhead compared to BOLT (S\&P'24) and a $2\times$ reduction compared to Bumblebee (NDSS'25), along with latency reductions of $13\times$ and $1.8\times$, respectively, when leveraging GPU acceleration.
candidates.reason: BLBは暗号化Transformer推論で線形層をHE、非線形層をMPCへ切り替える際の通信負荷を減らすため、層を細粒度演算へ分解し隣接線形演算を融合する。CKKSとMPC間の安全な変換、融合行列積プロトコルを導入し、BERT/GPT2のGPU評価でBOLT比通信21倍削減・遅延13倍短縮を報告する推論実行系の直接最適化。

candidates.title: MLWQ: Efficient Small Language Model Deployment via Multi-Level Weight Quantization
candidates.venue: Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing

priority_breakdown.matched_prestigious_venue: Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing

candidates.reason: MLWQは小規模言語モデルの事後量子化で、層間の損失と層内の重要度を同時に使ってビット幅を割り当て、層内重要度を細粒度に分割して量子化パラメータを調整する。資源制約端末への推論配備で容量・計算負荷を下げながら精度を維持する直接的な重み量子化方式。
